title: Energy & Power Systems
businessQuestion: How quickly can baseload clean energy (SMRs, fusion, grid batteries) meet data center load growth?
investorQuestion: Which energy producers command premium long-term power purchase agreements (PPAs)?
overview: Energy shows the widest deployment gap on the site: many records describe storage, grid and generation concepts still at proof of concept, while a smaller set — inverters, lithium cells, solar — is already at mass production. The business question is which concepts survive interconnection queues, permitting and the cost of capital, because technical feasibility alone rarely decides the outcome.
